notes.title: HypothesisInputWire stringified enums
notes.description: kind, scope, comparison are stored as strings (e.g. 'Invariant', 'EventCount', 'Ge') rather than enums in HypothesisInputWire. hypothesis_input_from_wire deserialises these strings back to the domain enums. This avoids deriving serde for domain types (which require Clone etc.) and matches the R5 pattern from m8-03.

notes.title: serde(default) on target_hypothesis for backward compat
notes.description: CounterexampleBundleRecord.target_hypothesis = Option<HypothesisInputWire> with #[serde(default)]. Pre-m8-07 bundles (without the field) deserialise as None. replay.rs then falls back to the m8-04 synthetic reconstruction (MinimisedPayload -> HypothesisInput).

notes.title: reconstruct_hypothesis priority: persisted first, fallback second
notes.description: reconstruct_hypothesis in replay.rs now checks bundle.target_hypothesis first (D3 contract). If Some, it calls hypothesis_input_from_wire to produce the HypothesisInput and overrides session_id to the synthetic replay session. If None (pre-m8-07), falls back to m8-04 MinimisedPayload reconstruction.

notes.title: ReplayerReport defined locally in tools.rs (not in chronos-cli)
notes.description: chronos-cli is a binary crate with no lib target, so we cannot use it as a dev-dependency from chronos-sandbox. ReplayReport struct is defined locally in tools.rs with only the fields needed for the test assertions.

notes.title: CHRONOS_DB_PATH env var for shared store between MCP and CLI
notes.description: The MCP server and the 'chronos test replay' subprocess need to read from the same SQLite store. CHRONOS_DB_PATH is set in the env when starting the MCP server (via start_with_db_path) and when spawning the replay subprocess (via replay_bundle).

smoke_subset: counterexample_tools (12 tests: ce1-ce12 — ce12 exercises the full persist -> reconstruct path with non-default invariant options)
e2e_connectivity (verifies MCP server starts and responds)
